output.scope_note: The paper reports ionic conductivities of quasi-solid-state Na+ electrolytes (UiO-66/PVDF-HFP hybrid, PVDF-HFP and Celgard separators soaked in 1.0 M NaPF6 in PC), measured by EIS.

records.material_as_written: UiO-66/PVDF-HFP hybrid separator-based QSS electrolyte (1.0 M NaPF6 in PC)
records.synthesis_method: non-solvent induced phase separation (separator); electrolyte by soaking in 1.0 M NaPF6 in PC
records.evidence_quote: presents an enhanced ionic conductivity of 2.44
records.notes: The paper does not explicitly state which UiO-66 loading (3, 6 or 9 wt%) gives 2.44 mS/cm; the text gives a range 2.15-2.83 mS/cm for the hybrid electrolytes. Temperature not stated for this value. Reported activation energy 1.33 kJ/mol is in kJ/mol, not eV, so left null.
